units.source_text: 可是……为什么，就是不具备确信……

en.t: But... why was it that he simply could not feel certain...

units.source_text: 瞧着一点点勒紧似的围住他的沙壁，他不情愿地想起刚才攀登时惨遭失败的情景……

en.t: Looking at the walls of sand surrounding him as if they were tightening little by little, he reluctantly recalled the scene of his miserable failed climb just moments before...

units.source_text: 他一味地挣扎，没有任何效果，只有全身麻痹似的无力感……

en.t: He had struggled blindly, to no effect at all, left only with a numb helplessness through his whole body...

units.source_text: 这里也许是受到沙子侵蚀，不适用约定俗成规矩的特殊世界吧……

en.t: Perhaps this was a special world eroded by sand, where ordinary accepted rules no longer applied...

units.source_text: 要疑惑的话，材料不知有多少……

en.t: If he wanted reasons to be suspicious, there were surely more than enough...

units.source_text: 譬如说，为他新准备了石油桶和铁铲子，假如这是事实的话，那么，趁他不知道拆掉绳梯也一定是事实。

en.t: For example, if it was true that an oil drum and an iron shovel had been newly prepared for him, then it must also be true that the rope ladder had been removed without his knowing.

units.source_text: 此外，那女人不作一句申辩，那老实的态度令人觉得可怕，

en.t: Besides, the woman did not offer a single word in her own defense, and that meek attitude was frightening,

units.source_text: 她的沉默，表明她安于活生生当牺牲品的现状，

en.t: her silence showed that she had accepted the present condition of being a living sacrifice,

units.source_text: 更反衬出事态的严重性，难道不能这样考虑吗？

en.t: and did it not make the gravity of the situation stand out all the more? Could he not think of it that way?

units.source_text: 这么说来，昨晚，女人反复提到的那些话，

en.t: In that case, the things the woman had repeatedly said last night

units.source_text: 似乎都以他会永远待在这儿为前提，

en.t: all seemed to have been premised on his staying here forever,

units.source_text: 看来也许并不是单纯的口误那么简单。

en.t: and perhaps they were not merely simple slips of the tongue after all.
